after.make_thumbs.py:
# writes thumbs/<name>_t.jpg.txt for every file in raw/
import pathlib

out = pathlib.Path('thumbs')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for src in sorted(pathlib.Path('raw').glob('*.jpg.txt')):
    name = src.name[: -len('.jpg.txt')]
    (out / f'{name}_t.jpg.txt').write_text(f'JPEG 256x192 thumbnail of {name}\n')

# writes thumbs/<name>_t.jpg.txt for every file in raw/
import pathlib

out = pathlib.Path('thumbs')
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for src in sorted(pathlib.Path('raw').glob('*.jpg.txt')):
    name = src.name[: -len('.jpg.txt')]
    (out / f'{name}_t.jpg.txt').write_text(f'JPEG 256x192 thumbnail of {name}\n')
